sloka: एवं तौ शापमुत्सृज्य ब्राह्मणौ विगतज्वरौ ।तां गां हि दुर्बलां वृद्धां ददतुर्ब्राह्मणाय वै ।। ७.५३.२३ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ tau śāpamutsṛjya brāhmaṇau vigatajvarau ।tāṁ gāṁ hi durbalāṁ vṛddhāṁ dadaturbrāhmaṇāya vai ।। 7.53.23 ॥

translations.english: Thus, having pronounced the curse, those two Brahmins, now free from distress, indeed gave that weak, old cow to a Brahmin.
